question: For each year, calculate the percentage of films that had exclusively female actors (meaning no male actors and no actors with unknown/unspecified gender). Consider actors with gender marked as 'Male' or 'None' as non-female. For the results, display the year, the total number of movies in that year, and the percentage of movies with exclusively female actors. Extract the year from the Movie.year field by taking the last 4 characters and converting to a number.
sql:
WITH movie_genders AS (
    SELECT 
        m.MID,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as year_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as female_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as male_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unknown_count
    FROM Movie m
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
),
exclusively_female AS (
    SELECT MID, year_num
    FROM movie_genders
    WHERE male_count = 0 
      AND unknown_count = 0 
      AND female_count > 0
),
movie_years AS (
    SELECT MID, CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) as year_num
    FROM Movie
)
SELECT 
    my.year_num,
    COUNT(*) as total_movies,
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(ef.MID) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as percentage_exclusively_female
FROM movie_years my
LEFT JOIN exclusively_female ef ON my.MID = ef.MID
GROUP BY my.year_num
ORDER BY my.year_num

{"sql": "-- Build the full query: percentage of movies per year with exclusively female actors
WITH movie_genders AS (
    SELECT 
        m.MID,
        CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as year_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as female_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as male_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unknown_count
    FROM Movie m
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
),
exclusively_female AS (
    SELECT MID, year_num
    FROM movie_genders
    WHERE male_count = 0 
      AND unknown_count = 0 
      AND female_count > 0
)
SELECT 
    m.year_num,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) as total_movies,
    1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ef.MID) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) * 100 as percentage_exclusively_female
FROM Movie m
LEFT JOIN exclusively_female ef ON m.MID = ef.MID
GROUP BY m.year_num
ORDER BY m.year_num"}

        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL OR p.Gender = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unknown_count

    JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
),
exclusively_female AS (
    SELECT MID, year_num
    FROM movie_genders
    WHERE male_count = 0 
      AND unknown_count = 0 
      AND female_count > 0
),
movie_years AS (
    SELECT MID, CAST(SUBSTR(year, -4) AS INTEGER) as year_num
